name: Prospect dashboard
ownerWords:
and can you setup Posthog tracking and Posthog dashboard for this Prospect & monitoring feature vertical? (2026-11-03, msg mw02k8m4)

왤캐 텅텅비어있노 걔라도 보여야되는거 아님? (2026-11-03, msg mw08t1g0, on the dashboard)
goal: The owner's PostHog dashboard 'Prospect and Watchlist' (https://us.posthog.com/project/354457/dashboard/2295680) shows data in every tile when he opens it, and stays fed. Build step p289 is done, so keeping it fed is upkeep (c110). The headline counts the insight tiles that load with no error and hold a row with a nonzero number, run the way the dashboard loads them; a tile of only zeros or nulls is what he called empty. The customer filter of every tile reads the PostHog warehouse tables prodconvex_orgs and prodconvex_orgmembers, which the prod Convex source 01a17c34-360e-0000-509d-3ae02d9d3fed syncs hourly; from 17:39Z on 11-03 to 01:49Z on 11-04 that source sat paused with 3 failed tables during the Convex outage and nothing noticed, so the source's tables are a metric. The State and Does it work tiles read the daily prod events prospect_state_day and watchlist_reads_day (convex/crons.ts runs search/pipeDays.fillDay at 04:41Z; registry ~/.pi/wiki/content/domains/product-analytics/posthog-events.yaml), so their age is a metric. On the first run (11-04 about 05:50Z) prod Convex befitting-sparrow-356 ran b1fb45b230, the 11-02 land, which holds no prospectStateDay.ts, so prod had never sent either event and 11 of 18 tiles read empty; the 11-03 04:42Z events in 354457 came from staging org ids.

metrics.label: Tiles of the Prospect and Watchlist dashboard that load with no error and show a nonzero number
Tables of the PostHog prod Convex source that a tile reads or that sync, which are paused, failed, or last synced over twice their interval ago
Hours since the newest prod prospect_state_day event, due once a day after the 04:41Z cron
Hours since the newest prod watchlist_reads_day event, due once a day after the 04:41Z cron

onMiss: Read the flagged slices first. source_tables_failing: each table_failing slice names the table and why. Fix it in the run with POSTHOG_ADMIN_API_KEY (auto-sns-agent apps/search/.env through node_modules/.bin/dotenvx get): PATCH https://us.posthog.com/api/projects/354457/external_data_schemas/<schema id>/ with should_sync true, which starts a sync at once, or POST .../external_data_sources/01a17c34-360e-0000-509d-3ae02d9d3fed/reload/, then read .../jobs/ for rows_synced. After the 11-03 outage the old Convex deploy key still worked once the team came back; an 'Access denied' while Convex team 453421 is up means the deploy key, which only the source's job_inputs hold. Turn on only tables a tile reads or that already synced, because each synced table walks the whole prod write log (memory posthog_354457_prod_convex_source_syncs_only_4_tables). Event ages: first read which commit prod runs with `node scripts/repo/convex/call.mjs revision befitting-sparrow-356` in auto-sns-agent. When that commit holds no convex/search/campaigns/prospectStateDay.ts, the senders are waiting on a prod promote, which the release owner walks with the owner (c154): tell the CI and RepoOps thread once with the reading, never dispatch or ask for a promote, and open no fix step. When prod holds the senders and the events still do not land, give one fix step with duty "<dutyId>/<metric key>" and one fix job (rlm.create_session) that reads otel.otel_logs through ops/bin/ch-ro prod for search/pipeDays:fillDay, prospectStateDay:send and '[posthog]' lines, checks prod's PUBLIC_POSTHOG_KEY (capturePostHog in convex/lib/posthog.ts sends nothing and logs nothing without it), and lands the fix on dev/sieun. tiles_with_data_pct: a tile_failing slice is a HogQL error or timeout, fixed in the tile's query through ~/work/prospect-posthog/dashboard.py, which builds the dashboard; a tile_empty slice whose events are late is the same cause as the event age, so fix that first; a tile that stays empty while its events arrive gets a fix step and a job that reads its HogQL against the events and fixes the query or the sender. A failures-only tile, such as 'failures by error code', reads empty while nothing fails; when that is the only empty tile, say so in the report and change the rule here rather than chase it. Nothing goes outside (c37). All on target: end the turn with no message.
